definition: Operations on raster/coverage data: reprojecting a coverage to another coordinate reference system, resampling it to another cell size, deriving a new raster from one or more others via a mathematical expression, a named radiometric index or a threshold, cropping a coverage to a region of interest, converting a coverage to another encoding, or depicting it as an image -- independent of any input/output signature or implementation (OGC 14-065 WPS 2.0.2 §7.5.1).

hasAction.description: The definition extends the operations the concept covers to resampling (Generic Profile raster-resampling), thresholding (raster-thresholding) and depicting a raster as an image (raster-rendering), added the same day under this concept (decision C5 of 2026-11-10). It was: "Operations on raster/coverage data: reprojecting a coverage to another coordinate reference system, deriving a new raster from one or more others via a mathematical expression or a named radiometric index, cropping a coverage to a region of interest, or converting a coverage to another encoding -- independent of any input/output signature or implementation (OGC 14-065 WPS 2.0.2 §7.5.1)."

The object identifier of this item moves from https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/concept/raster-coverage-processing to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/concept/raster-coverage-processing, which resolves through w3id.org (decision of 2026-11-17); the register actions of the item move with it, under https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/concept/raster-coverage-processing/actions/. The old IRI is kept as owl:sameAs. The content of the item is unchanged. Classified clarifying: the item is the same, only its identifier changes.
